brief: A Berlin Pride attack suspect was killed in a police shootout, and the US paused strikes on Iran amid ceasefire efforts, while wildfires in France forced mass evacuations. Research highlights usability of conversational AI and visualization tools for data analysis.
news_summary: Berlin Pride attacker killed in police shootout; US pauses Iran attacks; wildfires near Bordeaux evacuate over 330,000; Tadej Pogačar wins 2026 Tour de France as route shortened due to fires.
papers_summary: Studies evaluate usability of conversational product advisors, wearable AI for writing, and semantics-driven visualization tools, alongside accessibility for deaf students and ethical AI in dementia care.

zh.brief: 柏林同志遊行遭汽車衝撞釀死傷，嫌犯被警方擊斃；今年最強颱風「紅霞」登陸中國廣東，逾71萬人疏散。美國暫停對伊朗攻擊，談判有望重啟。
zh.news_summary: 柏林同志驕傲遊行遭汽車衝撞，造成1死16傷，嫌犯在警匪對峙中被擊斃。今年最強颱風「紅霞」登陸廣東，逾71萬人疏散。美國暫停對伊朗攻擊，雙方均顯示談判意願。
zh.papers_summary: 本周研究聚焦於人機互動，包括大型語言模型在對話產品顧問中的可用性、穿戴式AI輔助創意寫作，以及擴增實境在聽障學生學習中的應用。
